# ANALYSIS: WALKFORWARD_DTE_MONOTONICITY_2025Q3_2026Q2

**Filed:** 2026-08-27  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** walkforward_test  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that OOS expectancy per trade (exp/tr) increases with DTE for the vwap_continuation signal (or the general signal set) due to lower theta decay, showing monotonicity 0DTE < 1DTE < 2DTE across each quarter from 2025 Q3 to 2026 Q2.

## Mechanism

We will run a walk-forward test: for each quarter, train on previous quarters (or use expanding window) and test OOS on the quarter, computing average P&L per trade for 0DTE, 1DTE, 2DTE entries using the same signal (e.g., vwap_continuation) and same exit rules (-8%/+30%). Then test monotonicity via pairwise comparisons and compute p-values vs null (exp/tr = 0) using a t-test or bootstrap.
